newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NBM Amstelland to buy Dutch network firm.
newsitem.headline: NBM Amstelland to buy Dutch network firm.

text.p: Dutch construction group NBM-Amstelland NV said on Monday it expected to reach agreement on buying Van den Berg Zwammerdam Houdstermaatschappij BV from unlisted ULC Groep BV.
Van den Berg is active in building networks for cable television, traffic systems, data transmission and systems for the distribution of gas, water and electricity.
The unit posts annual turnover of about 90 million guilders and has 400 employees, NBM-Amstelland said. It did not disclose any financial details of the intended takeover.
NBM-Amstelland said Van den Berg's traffic systems activities were an addition to those of its own unit Verenigde VTN Bedrijven.
It added that the traffic systems sector was seen as a growth market, in which it planned to strengthen its position.

Van den Berg and VTN will be combined in a new NBM-Amstelland subsidiary which will be active in infrastructural projects. This new group will have about 600 employees and annual turnover of about 150 million guilders.
